user_query: I want to organize a company event and send out invitations to all clients, including environmental facts to raise awareness about sustainability.

TaskList.description: Retrieve an email invitation template from CakeMail API to ensure professional and customizable invitation content.
Fetch interesting environmental facts from Revista Verde API to include in the email for raising sustainability awareness.
Compose the email invitation by combining the template with the environmental facts, and prepare it for distribution.
Send out the email invitations to all clients using the prepared content.
